prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
competitors_mentioned: Arizona State Board of Dental Examiners
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on your needs (complexity of the case, health, budget and whether you want same clinician to place and restore the implant). Rather than one name, I can help you find the right provider. Here’s how to identify a top dentist for a dental implant in Phoenix and what to ask at a consult.

Who to look for
- Specialists who commonly place implants: oral and maxillofacial surgeons, periodontists, and prosthodontists. Many general dentists also place implants if they have advanced implant training.  
- For complex surgery (bone grafts, sinus lifts, full-arch work) prefer an oral surgeon or periodontist. For the final restoration (implant crown, bridge, denture) a prosthodontist or an experienced restorative dentist is ideal.  
- Team approach is common and good: a surgeon places the implant and a restorative dentist makes the crown, or one clinician does both if qualified.

Credentials and experience to check
- Licensure with the Arizona State Board of Dental Examiners.  
- Specialty board certification where applicable (e.g., American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, American Board of Periodontology, American Board of Prosthodontics).  
- How many implants they’ve placed (overall and of the same type as your case).  
- Experience with CBCT (3D) imaging, guided implant surgery, and the implant brands they use (Straumann, Nobel, Zimmer, etc.).  
- Before-and-after photos and patient references or reviews.  
- Hospital privileges for complex cases or medical complications (a good sign for surgeons).

Important questions to ask at a consult
- Am I a candidate for a dental implant? If not, why and what alternatives?  
- Who will do the surgery and who will do the crown? Will you coordinate care?  
- How many implants like mine have you placed? What is your success/complication rate?  
- Do you use CBCT and digital planning? Do you offer guided surgery?  
- Will I need bone graft/sinus lift? If so, what are the risks and costs?  
- What implant system and components will you use? Are the parts from well-known manufacturers?  
- What sedation/anesthesia options are available?  
- What’s the full estimated cost (surgery, grafting, abutment, crown) and financing?  
- What is the timeline from surgery to final crown?  
- Do you have before/after photos and patient testimonials?  
- How do you handle complications or implant failures? Are any warranties offered?

How to find local candidates
- Use ADA Find-a-Dentist, the Arizona Dental Association directory, Google and Yelp reviews, Healthgrades and realself for provider reviews and photos.  
- Ask your general dentist for a referral—your current dentist’s restorative relationship with a surgeon is a plus.  
- Check the Arizona State Board for any disciplinary actions.

If you want, I can:
- Compile a short list of well-reviewed implant dentists in Phoenix if you give your ZIP code or neighborhood, or
- Draft a short script/email you can use when calling for consults.

Which would you prefer?
